speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) how many Government and Statutory Board car parks as a proportion of the total number of these car parks provide free parking on Sundays; (b) how has this proportion varied from 2005 to 2010; and (c) whether the Ministry has plans to change this proportion in the years ahead.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The vast majority of these are HDB residential car parks.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I would just like to ask a supplementary question.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: And there are different stakeholders that need to use the car parks.
